lines.text: What makes a simple light bulb glow? The answer is something you cannot even see!
Electric current is the flow of electric charge through a conductor. A potential difference drives the current through the circuit.
But resistance opposes the flow of current. More resistance means less current when voltage remains constant.
This relationship is explained by Ohm's Law: Voltage equals Current multiplied by Resistance.
Now you know the science behind the light. Ready to test your understanding?
